snapshot.title: Boil Water Advisory — Zone 2

fields.resolution: ENDEX. The Director of Water Operations has confirmed the Boil Water Advisory is ready for release. The City Manager has approved the public statement. The Public Information Officer will now release the advisory via MillbrookAlert, the website, and social media. All systems remain isolated; manual operations are verified. The advisory will stay in place until two rounds of samples, taken 24 hours apart, show the water meets standards.
finalState: The Boil Water Advisory for Zone 2 has been officially released via MillbrookAlert, the website, and social media.
The media log and rumor log are now active under the Deputy PIO’s oversight.
The advisory remains in effect; two rounds of sampling are scheduled for 08:25 and 08:25 the next day.
The control network remains isolated; no restoration to SCADA or IT systems has been initiated.
The Incident Commander confirms the advisory is approved and the protocol is complete.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. Put down your phones and radios. We will take ten minutes, then start the hot wash.
fields.hotWashMethod: 3-Up, 3-Down: three things that went well, three things that broke
hotWashQuestions: How did the team validate the telemetry failure versus a real loss of disinfection?
What was the impact of the delayed public release on rumor control and customer trust?
How did the team balance the need for speed with the requirement to follow the approval chain in C6?
What role did the manual operations at Mill Road play in preventing further pressure loss?
How could the system’s isolation have been better managed to prevent cascading failures?
fields.facilitatorNote: Collect all ICS 201 forms and evaluator sheets before the break.
fields.scenarioTitle: Stale Signal — Radio Failure & Transmission Break

snapshot.instructorNote: This is the final event. The team has completed the Boil Water Advisory release and all required documentation. The hot wash should focus on process gaps, decision timing, and communication flow.
